command: python run_benchmark.py --exact brute --solvers sa,qaoa --baselines greedy --case testcases/tiny_a.flow:1:auto --case testcases/tiny_b.flow:2:auto --seed 0 --qaoa-reps 1 --qaoa-shots 2500 --qaoa-maxiter 20 --qaoa-max-qubits 24 --out results/shared_sa_qaoa.csv

protocol.sample_selection: At most20 lowest-energy SampleSet records; SA records can repeat bitstrings, QAOA records aggregate identical bitstrings. Report occurrence counts and record-count feasibility, not physical-shot success probabilities.
protocol.run_order: Each case: reference, SA, QAOA, greedy. No dedicated warmup. First QAOA call includes framework import; later calls reuse imported code.
protocol.timing: SA sampler and QAOA adapter wall times exclude BQM building and shared exact references; QAOA includes circuit build, training and shots. Scoring/repair separate. No statistical speedup inference from these single runs.
protocol.scope: Two tiny easy synthetic cases; both also solved by greedy. No hardware, physical routing or advantage claim. Circuit dimensions are logical only.
